items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Eddie Edwards is dead now too, I guess. He was the manager, I guess, in a way, and tried to run it... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, it was a co-op thing, and everybody had the same say-so...

ctx.x: You see, when we'd get on a bandstand and when it come time to play a number, well, one would say, let's play this and everyone would say, oh, let's play this, let's play that. And we'd be organ five, ten minutes before we'd get to play one tune. So I'd say, oh, let's play this and I'd just go off with it. Yeah, that's the way you do. So I got tired of that. I said, I'm going home.
Yeah. Well, Eddie Edwards is dead now too, I guess. He was the manager, I guess, in a way, and tried to run it, and then La Rocca was the leader, or so it was a...
Well, it was a co-op thing, and everybody had the same say-so, and that is where the trouble was.
